title: Silent Ship
about: A small background pirate gag where an imaginary ship instantly retreats from a sea monster.
description: This track captures a quiet bit of background comedy from Pirate Year. While the main dialogue continued, I acted out a tiny ship with my hands as another performer approached like a sea monster. Instead of fighting, the little captain immediately turned around and sailed away. It was the kind of joke most of the audience probably never noticed, but it became one of those small performance memories that stuck.

Lyrics: Wind was blowing nice and slow,
Up it rose with arms held high,
